def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    principal = 300000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.04
    loan_term_years = 30

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    total_payments = loan_term_years * 12
    monthly_payment = (
        principal * monthly_interest_rate
        / (1 - (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** -total_payments)
    )
    total_interest_paid = monthly_payment * total_payments - principal
    answer = round(total_interest_paid)

    # return answer
    return answer
